messages:
jacob_acme: Hey team — noticed a subtle change after the model bump yesterday (v6b rollout). Our in-app assistant answers are shorter and drop example steps. Not an API error, but CX is noticing less helpfulness. Anyone else seeing tone/verbosity drift?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste a small repro (prompt + the two responses: before & after) and a request_id or two? Also which model name your integration is calling? :thinking_face:

jacob_acme: Sure — prompt and samples below. We called the normal chat endpoint, model header shows redwood-v6b-compact. Request id: req-20250308-0912-0a1b2c.

Prompt:
```
User: "How do I reset my API key for a team member? Provide steps and a short example CLI request."
```

Response (before, from v6):
"Support: To reset a team member's API key, go to Settings > Team > Keys, click 'Revoke' next to the member, then 'Generate new key'. CLI example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.acme.com/keys/reset -d '{"user":"bob@example.com"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>'
```
This revokes the old key and provisions a new one — share securely with the teammate.
"

Response (after, from v6b):
"Support: Revoke the member's key in Settings > Team > Keys and generate a new one. Use curl to call the reset endpoint.
"

jacob_acme: You can see it's more terse (lost the step-by-step and example). Customers are asking for copies of example commands which used to be included.

maria_support: Thanks — that drop in worked example + briefness matches what we've seen in a couple other tickets. Not seeing API errors in your logs, so likely generation behavior/regression. Can you run the diagnostic curl with debug headers so we can grab the full request/response? Example: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug: 1" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v6b-compact","input":"How do I reset my API key for a team member? Provide steps and a short example CLI request.","max_tokens":150}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
```

jacob_acme: Ran it — attached the verbose dump to the support ticket. Header excerpt: `x-model: redwood-v6b-compact`, `x-request-id: req-20250308-0912-0a1b2c`, `x-llm-kv-cache: enabled`. No errors.

maria_support: Copy. I'm escalating to eng-ml for a possible behavior regression. @sam_ml can you take a look? We suspect either a checkpoint change or a generation param default tweak in the v6b rollout (maybe trimming helper content or a system-prompt compression).

sam_ml: Thanks for the ping — I'll start triage. Quick Qs for jacob_acme: 1) Can you share 3–5 representative prompts where brevity hurts output utility? 2) Any custom system prompts you inject? 3) Does pinning to the older model (redwood-v6-stable) restore the prior outputs for you if you can try?

jacob_acme: Uploaded 5 prompts to ticket #12345. No custom system prompt — we rely on the default assistant persona. I can test pinning but want the exact API snippet to do so.

maria_support: To pin, change the model field to the explicit legacy name, e.g.: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v6-stable","input":"<your prompt>","max_tokens":150}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
```
If that gives the old verbose form, please paste both outputs here.

jacob_acme: I tried pinning. redwood-v6-stable returns the longer, example-rich reply like before. v6b returns the concise one. Confirmed with same max_tokens and temperature in both calls.

sam_ml: That helps a lot — sounds like a behavioral delta between checkpoints. Next steps from our side: 1) we'll reproduce locally against both checkpoints with your prompts, 2) run a diff on token-level generation (where examples are removed), 3) check if the system assistant prompt or generation defaults were modified in the v6b rollout (e.g., instruction-following penalties or content-pruning heuristics). ETA 48 hrs.

maria_support: We've created an internal incident & linked the ticket. If you can, please add any conversation logs or customer-facing messages where the lack of examples caused confusion — useful for severity. We'll follow up in the ticket and here with updates. Thank you and sorry for the regression — we're on it :raised_hands:

eng-bot: Deploy note: v6b-compact rolled to 40% traffic 2025-03-07 22:15 UTC; rollout includes kernel optimization + revised pruning heuristics.

jacob_acme: Thanks for the quick triage. I'll keep uploads flowing into the ticket. Appreciate the ETA.

maria_support: If anything regresses to blocking, react with :rotating_light: in the ticket and we will escalate to an immediate rollback. Otherwise we'll post findings in 48 hours.

sam_ml: Also tagging this for a possible quick mitigation (adjust generation defaults for v6b to include more exemplars) if we confirm the root cause.

jacob_acme: Good plan — thanks all."
